Kit summary

FrostBasic
Deals 240% DEF DMG to a single enemy. If the enemy is under SPD Down or [Freeze] status, this attack deals extra DMG by 5% of the target's Max HP. The extra DMG caps at 10% of Gramndi's Max HP. This attack has an additional 40% Leech.
Zero DegreeActive
Deals 140% DEF DMG to a single enemy and reduces their Turn Meter by 50%, with a 100% chance to inflict [Freeze] for 1 turn.
Ice PhysiquePassiveExclusive Lv.1 · Lv.2 · Lv.3
Gramndi is immune to SPD Down and [Freeze]. When Gramndi takes Direct DMG, there is a 70% chance to reduce the attacker's SPD by 20% for 2 turns. If the attacker is already under the SPD Down status, there is a 70% chance to inflict [Freeze] on them instead for 1 turn.
Frost Club Lv.1Gramndi is immune to death and restores self HP by 40% of Max HP when taking Fatal DMG. Skill CD: 5 turns.
Frost Club Lv.2Gramndi reduces the Turn Meters of enemy targets under SPD Down or [Freeze] status by 10% at the start of his turn.
Frost Club Lv.3Gramndi deals 40% more DMG to and takes 20% less DMG from targets under SPD Down or [Freeze] status.
King of FrostActive
Deals 140% DEF DMG to all enemies, with a 50% chance to reduce their SPD by 20% for 2 turns and a 50% chance to inflict [Freeze] for 1 turn.
